MORE: In pursuance to the applicable provisions of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, have, inter alia, considered and approved the unaudited standalone financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
